newsitem.title: USA: Shorewood sees $0.02 per share Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Shorewood sees $0.02 per share Q4 charge.

text.p: Shorewood Packaging Corp said Monday it will record in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 a net charge of $334,000, or $0.02, per share representing a write-off of deferred finance costs connected to the company's existing credit facility.
Separately, Shorewood said it increased the number of its common shares authorized for repurchase from about 1.26 million shares (remaining under previous Board resolutions) to 2.5 million shares.
Shorewood said it will build a 125,000 square foot plant in the Peoples Republic of China.
The company said the facility will be located in the Southeast Region of mainland China in the city of Guangzhou, in the Guandong Province.
The initial investment in China will approximate $35 million for initial capacity of about $75 million, the company said.
The facility is expected to be completed by the end of calendar 1997 and the company said it expects to commence operations in the Spring of 1998.
In order to facilitate its expansion, Shorewood said it entered into a new credit agreement with its lending banks to replace its existing credit facility.

The new credit facility provides for up to $200 million of borrowings and consists of a $75 million term loan to be amortized in equal quarterly installments over five years and a $125 million revolving credit facility (including US$25 million in Canada) maturing at the end of five years, the company said.
